description: Arizona lawmakers are advancing SB1475, legislation sponsored by Senator Mark Finchem to strengthen eligibility standards for interscholastic activities and protect student environments. SB1475 establishes clear rules that make students ineligible to participate in school athletics or activities if they have committed certain criminal offenses, helping schools maintain safe and structured programs.
